name: Sentaro
summary: Email threat detection that flags phishing, risky and malicious messages right in your inbox. Surfaces the dangerous emails that look perfectly normal — before anyone clicks.
best_for: SMBs on Google Workspace/M365 that want an extra AI layer against phishing and BEC without infrastructure changes
skip_if: you already run a mature email-security stack (Ironscales/Abnormal-class), or nobody internally will review the flagged-mail queue
honest_knock: The category claim (AI catches what filters miss) is plausible — Microsoft/Google native filtering misses sophisticated BEC — but any vendor's accuracy percentage is measured on their own test set, not your mail flow. The honest procurement move: run their trial alongside your current filtering, count real catches and false positives for two weeks, and price per mailbox against the incumbents with that data in hand.

pricing.notes: (read 24 September 2026 on sentaro.com/en/pricing) Priced per protected account, in USD. Pro is $6 per protected account per month after the first account, or $68 per account per year, about $5.67 a month and roughly 5.6% below monthly. The first account stays free. A Free single-user tier (one account, private or company-attached, no card, no expiry) is listed but marked 'coming soon'. Sovereign is custom annual pricing: dedicated EU tenancy, custom DPA and audit support, SIEM export and API access, and a named security engineer. A protected account is one mailbox Sentaro watches; shared aliases and distribution lists do not count. The page states that every feature is in every plan, and Pro lists cross-vector response (block, quarantine, forced re-auth, session revocation), the admin console, audit trail and reporting, and cancel anytime. Monthly plans stop at the end of the period; purchases through Paddle carry a full refund within 14 days, renewals included. History: no price was published until August 2026. On 5 September the site showed Professional at $6 monthly or $5.50 annual, with the same numerals offered in euros, and SSO/SCIM, API access and compliance support on a quote-only Enterprise tier; that layout is gone.
